mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 5.5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 0.4 percentage points for three consecutive months signals a tightening labor market, which raises wage pressures and inflation expectations, ultimately leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings growth outpaces expectations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > previous month +0.4pp for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and a fall in UNRATE above 0.3 percentage points over two months indicates a situation of rising employment but stagnant wage growth, which compresses input costs and boosts profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp over two months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in at least 55% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for two consecutive months signals a significant slowdown in industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month -0.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and RSAFS above their respective 12-month moving averages signals increased housing and retail demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12M MA and RSAFS > 12M MA simultaneously
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.4% signals a breakout in inflation, which prompts expectations of tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent annualized decline in GDPC1 below 1% for four consecutive quarters signals a prolonged economic stagnation, which erodes earnings and cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of current regime.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 1% annualized for four consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in at least 55% of triggered episodes.
